quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000, Strange Part x1

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why have you got your fishing rod out over here? Are you really fishing?

dialogues.speaker: Iara
dialogues.text: There's water, and a rod... of course I'm fishing. To think that you outsiders don't even know that... What's this world coming to, seriously?

choices.text: I don't think this has anything to do with global trends...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! We're not complete amateurs at fishing either, y'know!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What Paimon meant to say is... Y'know, that it's kinda weird for a Melusine to be using a fishing rod. Paimon didn't think you fished like that.

response.speaker: Iara
response.text: I—I'm not being weird! I learned this from an outsider. Delaroche is a great person. She not only taught me how to fish, but she also gave me a rod too!

response.speaker: Iara
response.text: Hers looked nicer, of course, but that's fine — she's a "professional," and I'm just a "hobbyist."

response.speaker: Iara
response.text: Still... I've been waiting here for so long. Why haven't I gotten a bite yet?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, in that case, why don't you let us pros help you figure out where you're going wrong!

response.speaker: Iara
response.text: Huh? Are the two of you really better than Delaroche? She's a professional with a very pretty fishing rod...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph! Looks like we might have to prove our skills, eh?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But are there actually any fish here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh. Now that you mention it, there really aren't any! Paimon thought that was weird right from the get-go, too.

response.speaker: Iara
response.text: Fish... Delaroche did say that not all waters have fish in them. Um, does "that" count as a fish?

response.speaker: Iara
response.text: If "that" isn't a fish, could it be the reason I can't "fish" it up in the first place?

response.speaker: Iara
response.text: #Master {NICKNAME}, Master Paimon, please, tell me. What must I do to fish "that" up?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, you... sure are polite! Well, of course we'll help you — but first off, what's "that" thing you're referring to?

response.speaker: Iara
response.text: It moves very quickly in the water, and it's so slippery that it's really hard to catch.

choices.text: That does sound like a fish.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But it could also be some other underwater creature, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, whatever the case, we can be sure that it's something that lives in the water, but since we can't really see its silhouette, it must be hiding deep down.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The way Paimon sees it, we need to spread some bait out and get it to come to the surface...

response.speaker: Iara
response.text: But it ate so much bait already... I'm not sure if switching baits will help.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, let's just spread some out first and prepare our rod, then wait for it to bite. We don't know what it is yet, but oh well.

response.speaker: Iara
response.text: #What beautiful technique... Let me try again. I'll give you the bait, Master {NICKNAME}, Master Paimon, and then I'll ready my rod... Even though it's not a professional's pretty rod...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, that's not a problem. Just leave spreading the bait out to us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seriously? Wouldn't it be weird if Iara and other Melusines were to play pretend fishing games together?

choices.text: I'm sure Paimon knows what fishing is.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true, you did fish Paimon out of the water back then, didn't you... Wait a minute, that's not the problem here!

dialogues.speaker: Iara
dialogues.text: ...Will it still be attracted to bait?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Iara places the weakened Ball Octopus into a waiting bucket...

dialogues.speaker: Iara
dialogues.text: What lovely fishing technique... But this creature is now no longer beautiful. How did this happen?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sorry... We didn't think the "thing" you were talking about was a Ball Octopus, so we, err...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, you were way too hasty! Well, Paimon didn't stop you either...

response.speaker: Iara
response.text: Don't apologize. It is in the bucket now, and that's enough for me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If you say so... But seriously, how did a Ball Octopus end up here? Did it follow the flow and then fall in by accident?

response.speaker: Iara
response.text: I caught it outside.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, what?

response.speaker: Iara
response.text: I wanted to be sure of my skills at using the fishing rod, which is why I went to go catch that... "Ball Octopus," I think you called it.

response.speaker: Iara
response.text: If I put it in here, I'd be able to fish it up whenever I wanted.

response.speaker: Iara
response.text: ...Or that was the plan, anyway. But I waited and waited, and it wouldn't bite no matter what.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's kinda concerning how you captured one and put it in a pool to practice fishing with a rod...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we just spread some bait out into the water, and it came out just like that. Didn't you think of doing something like that, Iara?

response.speaker: Iara
response.text: I tried many different types of bait, like minced meat, bread crumbs, worms, mints, components... It would just eat them and then disappear. I was even starting to think that bait had no effect on it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Components!? That, err, doesn't sound like bait...

choices.text: Best not to feed strange things to aquatic products...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right— Hang on, what kinda name is "aquatic products"?

response.speaker: Iara
response.text: Hmm. Components are very, very important. Since they're not meant to be used as bait, I need to find a way to get them back.

response.speaker: Iara
response.text: #Anyway, Master {NICKNAME} and Master Paimon, please take this component as thanks for your help!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, it's fine, we didn't do all that much, anyway...

response.speaker: Iara
response.text: Eh? But Delaroche said that you need to call people "Master" when you ask them for help, and that they will like it when you pay them "consultation fees." Is that not the case?

response.speaker: Iara
response.text: Please, take this dry component. It will be very useful to you in Merusea Village.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, if you say so, Iara... Thanks a lot!

response.speaker: Iara
response.text: Yes. I hope that I can learn more beautiful fishing techniques from you two in the future as well.

choices.text: So Ball Octopuses can actually eat mechanical components...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Isn't this more like "eaten by mistake"?

choices.text: I was concerned that it might attack us...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... When there's danger at hand, you've gotta strike first, y'know. But, well...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Iara places the weakened Ball Octopus into a waiting bucket...
